desc: 暖调卧室家纺套图：泼水成珠、静音剖面与深袋贴合层层递进收口礼盒
leaf: 绗缝防水静音床垫保护罩
name: 绗缝静音防水床垫保护罩款

shots.intent: 搜索列表第一眼就用泼翻不渗的主张抢点击，一秒讲清核心利益。
把夜间泼翻渗进裸床垫的日常焦虑摆到眼前，逼出换保护罩的理由。
让有孩家庭把自己代入明亮的床上早餐时刻，完成情感投射。
用夜间同机位双栏安静对照承接睡眠打扰焦虑，主张全部留空。
shots.textZone: 左上两行空白对照条各带一枚短标签位「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」，无数值刻度

shots.intent: 掀开一角露出正反两面与分层结构，用可见构造解释为什么防渗又安静。
shots.textZone: 右下三层剖面各带一行空标签位「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」，无成分字样

shots.intent: 用顶视微距把线迹与绒面质感推到眼前，替文字形容做质量背书。
侧面 90 度看清裙边拉伸与包裹下沿，消掉合不合床的最后疑虑。
shots.textZone: 画面中部一枚竖向空白标注线，其短标签位「{callout_1}」，数值槽完全留空

shots.intent: 用六格拼贴把适用人群铺成一整面，让每位买家都能在其中找到自己。
shots.textZone: 六格各一枚空白标题板，仅以「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」占位，其余留空线

shots.intent: 以整叠成品与无标礼盒俯视收口，把送礼与到手内容讲成风险消除。
shots.textZone: 三枚空白图标盘各带一行短标签位「{selling_point_1}」「{selling_point_2}」「{selling_point_3}」，侧缘一枚空白印章框

style.backgroundSystem: seamless studio fields alternating clean white #FFFFFF, warm sand #E9DECF and dull greige #D8CDBC, with cream plaster bedroom walls #EFE3D2 and a pale frosted stone plate #EFE6D8 in info frames; night frames drop to deep walnut #4A3428
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons inside flat rounded squares, deep walnut #4A3428 strokes on warm sand, one blank label slot under each disc, accent used only on frost-green #6F8F7D marks
style.lightingSystem: warm soft key from the front-left with a bounce fill, 2900-3800K in scenes, low-contrast gentle contact shadows, no harsh speculars; night frames lit by one warm lamp pool with soft falloff
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm heirloom bedroom-textile ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, warm sand #E9DECF, deep walnut #4A3428 and one frost-green accent #6F8F7D; warm soft key light from the front-left with a bounce fill, low-contrast gentle contact shadows and no harsh speculars; modern geometric sans-serif used only on blank placeholder plates; thin single-weight line icons inside flat rounded squares with blank label slots; seamless studio fields alternating white, warm sand and dull greige, plus cream plaster walls, walnut furniture and jute rug in lifestyle frames and deep walnut in night frames; the textile always rendered as a matte quilted top face with a pale brushed underside and a neatly tucked elastic skirt; stable product angle and scale across the set; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no printed brand artwork on packaging
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 or straight-on angle for the quilted textile, consistent quilting pattern scale across the set, tucked corner always readable, nothing covering the elastic skirt edge
style.surfaceSystem: matte warm plaster walls, walnut bed frames and sideboards, coarse jute rug weave, pale frosted stone plate #EFE6D8 as the info-table surface
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, one headline plus one short sub-line only, always carried on blank placeholder plates
